# Vendored third-party code

Vendored (not CDN-loaded) so the viewer works on a judge's machine without
outbound internet access during evaluation — same reasoning as this repo's
vendored Grafana plugins (see ../../../../NOTICE).

- **three.module.js** — [Three.js](https://threejs.org) r169, MIT License, Copyright 2010-2024 Three.js Authors.
- **OrbitControls.js** — part of the Three.js examples, same license and copyright.

Unmodified except for the files being fetched directly from the pinned r169 release.
